arabic text: LABO’N TAK KHOON SE MASHKIZA BHARA HAI
english translation text: The standard returns from the river; the water-skin is filled to the lips with blood.

arabic text: ALAM KO DOOR SE DEKHA JO USNE\nSAKINA KO LAGA USKA CHACHA HAI
english translation text: When she saw the standard from afar,\nSakina thought her uncle was returning.

arabic text: KOI AHLE HARAM KO YEH BATADO\nARE GHAZI WAHI PER SOGAYA HAI
english translation text: Someone tell the sacred family:\nGhazi has fallen asleep beside the river.

arabic text: HAI’N BACHE KHUSH KE MILJAEGA PANI\nNAHI MALOOM GHAZI MARCHUKA HAI
english translation text: The children rejoice, thinking they will receive water;\nthey do not know that Ghazi has died.

arabic text: KAHI’N PER HAI PARE TUKRE BADAN KE\nKAHI’N BAZOO KAHI’N PE SAR PARA HAI
english translation text: Pieces of the body lie in one place,\nan arm elsewhere, and the head somewhere else.

arabic text: LAGA HAI TEER AANKHON ME JARI KE\nLAEE’N KA GURZ MAATHE PER LAGA HAI
english translation text: An arrow is lodged within the warrior's eye,\nand the accursed one's mace struck his forehead.

arabic text: JANAZA KAISE LAATE SHAHE WALA\nBADAN GHAZI KA TUKRE HO GAYA HAI
english translation text: How could the exalted King bring the funeral bier,\nwhen Ghazi's body had been torn into pieces?

arabic text: ZARA SOCHO MERA ABBAS KAISE\nBINA BAZU KE GHORE SE GIRA HAI
english translation text: Just imagine how my Abbas\nfell from the horse without arms.

arabic text: KARIM AZLAN IK BACHI KI KHATIR\nALAM PE AB BHI MASHKIZA BANDHA HAI
english translation text: O Karim and Azlaan, for the sake of one little child,\nthe water-skin remains tied to the standard even now.
